credits.title: Someone Special
credits.overview: A man and a woman, living just a floor apart, are battling personal traumas. They are brought together by a twist of fate, kindling an unexpected relationship.

credits.title: O-Negative
credits.overview: A group of five teenagers of the same blood-type 'O' become friends at art college. Prim has a crush on bad boy Art, while her friend Foon likes quiet Puen. The five form a band and survive freshman initiation rituals, but conflict erupts when romances break up the group's harmony.

credits.title: Red Bike Story
credits.overview: A heartwarming movie about freshman university students coming of age and discovering the meaning of love.
